newsitem.title: USA: US DOE could start selling $220 mln SPR oil in Nov.
newsitem.headline: US DOE could start selling $220 mln SPR oil in Nov.

text.p: The U.S. Energy Department could start selling $220 million worth of government stockpile oil authorized in a broad spending bill as soon as early November, Energy Secretary Hazel O'Leary said.

"If we get the legislation today we have plans to move as quickly as we are directed to and we could probably move the SPRO (Strategic Petroleum Reserve oil) sometime in early November," O'Leary told reporters.
Congress authorized the oil sale in a broad spending bill to cover several agencies' budgets. It called for the sale of oil from the emergency stockpile to raise $220 million by Sept 30, 1997.
O'Leary, speaking to reporters after meeting with several congressmen on another issue, said the department was getting ready for the sale.
